mapper.select: SELECT userid, name, email, phone, role, height FROM account2 WHERE role IN ('MEMBER', 'PTMEMBER')
SELECT userid, name, email, phone, role, height FROM account2 WHERE role = 'MEMBER'
SELECT userid, name, email, phone, role, height FROM account2 WHERE role = 'PTMEMBER'
SELECT userid, name, email, phone, role, height FROM account2 WHERE userid = #{userId} AND role = 'MEMBER'
SELECT userid, name, email, phone, role, height FROM account2 WHERE name = #{userName} AND role = 'MEMBER'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account2 (userid, password, name, email, phone, role, height) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{height})
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET password = #{password}, name = #{userName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, height = #{height} WHERE userid = #{userId}
